# Careers

## Work with the best!

### We've Got Your Back

[Midwest Locations](https://secure.entertimeonline.com/ta/CBIZ20164.careers?CareersSearch=&lang=en-US)

[West Coast Locations](https://doctorsofphysicaltherapy.applytojob.com/apply)

At Doctors of Physical Therapy (DPT), we believe in delivering exceptional, evidence-based care that truly improves lives. Our team of dedicated professionals is at the heart of our success, and we’re always looking for talented, passionate individuals who share our mission to help patients move better, recover faster, and live healthier lives.

At Doctors of Physical Therapy, you’ll do more than find a job, you’ll build a meaningful career helping people get back to what they love. Join us in making a difference, one patient at a time.

## Let’s Redefine Care Together

### Why Work with Us?

- **Patient-Centered** Philosophy

We prioritize quality time with patients, using hands-on care and personalized treatment plans to ensure exceptional outcomes.
- **Collaborative Culture**

Work alongside skilled clinicians in an environment that values teamwork, mentorship, and shared expertise. We believe we’re better together.
- **Growth & Development**

Whether you’re early in your career or an experienced clinician, we invest in your professional development with continuing education, training support, and clear paths for advancement.
- **Expanding Locations**

Be part of a growing organization with over 85 clinics (and counting). Opportunities abound for leadership roles, specialization, and relocation if you choose.

![Doctors of Physical Therapy Services](https://doctorsofphysicaltherapy.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Doctors-of-Physical-Therapy-1024x967.webp)

## Current Openings

Ready to take the next step? Explore our current opportunities and apply today.

If you don’t see a role that fits but think you’d be a great addition to our team, please email our HR Director, Jayme at jelliot@drsofpt.com
